summary.one_line: Mods is a separate bilingual section and player pages state release availability without developer build instructions.

purpose.evidence: Read all nine review:info Markdown paths. The requested Mods area is now a separate top-level section rather than a Players subgroup. Its RU/EN catalog and two product pages describe features, availability, controls and limits for players, while developer build/test launch instructions move behind the modding/devkit entry. The page purpose no longer asks players to compile C++ or run Python to use the knowledge base.

structure.evidence: mkdocs nav adds a Mods group in RU and EN; theme header and article sidebar include the localized mods key. Catalog, predictor and bank pages all set section: mods in both languages; the game-placement page remains Players. Their filenames stay under docs/players to retain published URLs, as README states. Catalog is landing, product pages are reference, and the developer section owns build links, matching the site's content-type rules.

specificity.evidence: Both catalogs say no ready-to-use player archive exists and GitHub Code/ZIP links are source, not installed mods. Predictor page explains that a simple public package is unavailable and links developer instructions; bank page states H5U alone does not enable the full reference and points to developer diagnostic launch. Bank use/tiers, 13-family/19-title/12-Type limits, predictor controls and pinned-build/combined-use caveats remain. No developer install command is stranded on player pages.

reproducibility.evidence: Parent reports final site build/check passing: 8 Node, 23 Python and 41 HTML pages, plus 13 browser tests. The changed pages contain no new claim of a fresh game run or a ready player release. Developers can follow canonical public mod READMEs from modding/devkit; I checked the links and their purpose against the previously reviewed mod source guides, but did not launch either mod.

evidence.evidence: The exact diff changes navigation/category metadata and editorial placement, not game data, screenshots, code or recorded experiment results. Public mod repositories previously reviewed document predictor DLL+loader versus bank H5U+native diagnostic launch; the new player copy summarizes availability without pretending either is copy-and-play. I did not scan a game/profile, and passing site tests do not certify mod gameplay.

applicability.evidence: The mod pages continue to scope features to the investigated Universe build and mark other versions/combined use unverified. Player text says no distributable archive yet; developer links lead to source builds rather than implying normal installation. README preserves existing URLs; site navigation now reflects the user's requested audience split without changing permalinks.

translations.evidence: Compared RU/EN nav, labels and six page metadata records: `mods` is used identically and the catalog/product pages convey the same no-release status, source-code warning, developer-link handoff and retained limits. Both developer pages add a mod-sources section with links to predictor and bank READMEs. No substantive translation mismatch found.

maintenance.evidence: A single `extra.labels.mods` per language is reused in header/sidebar. The six existing article URLs remain unchanged, avoiding broken bookmarks; README records that choice. Developer build guidance stays canonical in the mod repos, with site devkit as a pointer rather than duplicating long commands on player pages. review:info lists nine Markdown paths, all covered here; no source file was edited by this reviewer.
